title: QA Engineer
description:
We are looking for **QA Engineers** with 2–3 years of experience in **Manual and Automation Testing** to join our team. The ideal candidate should have good testing knowledge, hands\-on automation experience, and excellent communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform manual testing of Frontend and Backend applications.
* Create and execute test cases and test scenarios.
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, integration, and API testing.
* Develop and execute automated test scripts.
* Identify, report, and track bugs using Jira or similar tools.
* Perform basic API testing using Postman.
* Work closely with developers and other team members to identify and resolve issues.
* Maintain test cases, automation scripts, and test documentation.

**Requirements**

* 2\-3 years of experience in Software Testing/QA.
* Good knowledge of **Manual and Automation Testing**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools**.
* Basic knowledge of **API Testing and SQL**.
* Knowledge of any programming language such as **Java, Python, or JavaScript**.
* Good understanding of software testing processes.
* **Excellent verbal and written communication skills.**
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a team.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work on real\-world projects.
* Exposure to both manual and automation testing.
* Learning and growth opportunities.
* Collaborative and supportive work environment.

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Software Engineering Lead - .Net, Automation
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Focus on leads and individual contributors who are highly technical with respect to C\#, .Net, Cloud Architecture, Azure Services, containerization strategy micro services, REST, .Net Core and Web APIs
* Overall regression automation and maintenance
* Work with business analysts and programmers to create and analyze various required project documents
* Comply with standards and strategies of the software development life cycle
* Developing and executing comprehensive suites of test plans and test cases for system and integration testing, maintaining and continued evaluation of test cases for inclusion in regression
* Work closely with Developers and other QA engineers to deliver the highest quality products in a timely and cost\-effective manner
* Create, maintain and execute test plans and test cases, analyzing and communicating test results, defect tracking and participating in day\-to\-day QA Activities
* Collaborate with stakeholders, business, Partner Solution Architects, and Technical Architects to ensure that the Solution is accurate to deliver outcomes to the client and reliable from a technology perspective
* Understand and communicate new product and solution requirements back to the solution development and management team
* Lead others toward technical accomplishment, collaborative project team efforts and achievement of important project goals
* Independent communication with business partners to resolve design issues and negotiate project related items such as priorities and completion deadlines
* This role include, but are not limited to analysis, design, coding, engineering, testing, debugging, standards, methods, tools analysis, documentation, research and development, maintenance, new development, operations and delivery
* Deliver leading healthcare products
* Enhance existing products as well as create new offerings utilizing the latest technology
* Build and lead a product development team to deliver projects that meet business objectives and solve critical user problems
* Collaborate closely with key leaders to develop strategic projects, plans and processes, streamline decision\-making, and develop and manage an engineering team
* Leverage technical expertise and industry trends to influence development processes and product quality
* Act as a technical leader in internal teams including managing code reviews, post project analysis and clearly articulating throughout the duration of projects what is important to the project's success and focuses on the critical few and priorities to improve
* Provide leadership for planning, recruiting and managing part of a world class technology, product development and application engineering team delivering a world class enterprise solutions portfolio and offering enabling services
* Effectively implement SDLC, modifying it as necessary, utilizing best practices across the company and/or industry
* Develop and apply highly effective team operating mechanisms to achieve the business objectives
* Continuously assess, and if necessary, redesign processes to ensure that they are repeatable, sustainable and scalable
* Drive results through proactively collaborating across organizational boundaries, and ensures end\- to\-end execution that most effectively delivers for the right stakeholders
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* B.Tech/MCA/MTech (Minimum 10 years of formal education, correspondence courses are not relevant)
* 10\+ years of experience in developing software systems
* Hands\-on experience in Designing, Developing and Managing solution in Azure platform
* Hands\-on development experience using App Service, Azure Function, Azure Storage, service bus queues, Event hubs, Event Grid, Application gateway, Azure SQL etc.
* Hands\-on experience in designing and developing DevOps pipeline using GITHUB actions, IaC, Azure DevOps, Terraform etc.
* Experience with front\-end and back\-end Quality Engineering tools and methodologies
* Experience with test automation tools like TestNG, Selenium, Maven, and Jenkins
* Experience with defect tracking applications
* Experience data testing SQL database query tools
* Experience creating, designing, and executing comprehensive tests plans
* Experience developing high level and detailed test strategy, test plans, test cases, test scripts, manual testing, test automation and defect tracking using various tools such as ALM, Jenkins and Jira, Java, Oracle, etc.
* Experience STLC and functionality, system, regression, integration
* Experience with software development lifecycle methodologies and frameworks such as Agile, Scrum, Test Driven Development, etc.
* Proven experience with defect tracking applications
* Excellent knowledge of quality assurance principles, techniques and tools
* Good understanding of AI/ML technologies, tools and prefer to have hands on building application knowledge
* Expertise level of exposure to .Net and .Net Core stack with SPA framework Angular/React
* Proven ability to drive strategic technology/engine reuse, technology and architecture health, and development process improvement
* Proven ability to evaluate tools/technologies and demonstrate through POC if required

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: QA Engineer
description:
**Job Title: QA \& Data Analyst** 

**Purpose of Job** 

ScaleupAlly is looking for a **QA \& Data Analyst** to join our team. This entry\-level role is ideal for those with basic knowledge of **software testing and data analysis** who want to build their career in both areas.

The role involves supporting **testing, defect reporting, data validation, and basic data analysis** to ensure application quality and data accuracy.

**Required Qualifications**

● Bachelor's degree in any discipline / Information Systems, or a related field.

**Skills**

SQL \| MS Excel \| Power BI \| Manual Testing \| API Testing \| Postman \| Swagger \| JIRA \| Data Validation \| Database Testing \| Basic Python \| Automation Basics

**Duties**

* Perform functional, regression, and basic exploratory testing.
* Create and execute test cases and scenarios.
* Identify and report bugs using JIRA.
* Perform API testing using Postman/Swagger.
* Validate data using SQL and Excel.
* Identify data errors, duplicates, and inconsistencies.
* Assist with dashboard and report validation.
* Prepare basic testing and data analysis reports.

**Required Qualification :**

* 0–12 months of experience in QA, Software Testing, Data Analysis, or a related area.
* Freshers with relevant academic projects, internships, or practical exposure can apply.
* Basic understanding of QA and Data Analytics concepts.
* Good analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.
* Ability to work across QA/testing and data analytics

● Working hours: **10:00 AM – 7:00 PM**

● Working days: **5 days a week** (plus 1st \& 3rd Saturdays working)

● **Quarterly parties and yearly outings/trips** for team bonding

● **Regular check\-ins** with leadership for growth and feedback

● **Recognition awards** to celebrate high performance

● **Fun activities** and team engagement sessions throughout the year

Pay: Up to ₹300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund
